name: Appsmith

pricing.free_plan: $0: up to 5 users in the cloud, 5 workspaces, 3 Git repos, public apps

capabilities: Builds dashboards and internal tools on top of a database
AI assists with queries and widgets
Free plan can publish an app that is publicly reachable
limits: Free plan stops at five users
Not a website builder; it produces apps with tables and forms
Data source has to be connected first
A fresh workspace opens with 'Your trial will expire in 15 days' above the editor, although the pricing page lists a free tier (seen 17.11.2026)
run_blocker: Data layer is ready: a small bookings API with twenty rows, server-side search and status filter, an update route and a CSV route, reachable through a tunnel, plus a working REST query in Appsmith (20 records returned, filters bound). The run stops at the editor automation: dragging the table widget is not reliable in a driven browser, a keystroke landed in a column binding and the app now renders blank in the editor. Not a product limit - a manual drag of one table widget is enough to continue (17.11.2026).
